verdict.summary: The lazy per-permutation cache is keyed consistently by the six repr-compatible enum discriminants, preserves SPO as an allocation-free alias, and uses binary-search bounds over sorted projected rows. Cache invalidation occurs before every non-empty delta mutation, covering both insertion and pending-insertion retraction, while cloned overlays retain caches that remain valid for their cloned added set. The expanded equivalence sweep compares scans, sort order, estimates, and repeated mutations against rebuilt stores; the focused zero-copy test also warms non-SPO caches and witnesses both growth and shrink invalidation on real scan paths. Heap accounting includes materialized projections. No correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity defect was found in the diff.
